summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 campaign and have been busy preparing with some exciting new signings and returnees joining the squad. The Ramblers are looking sharp in pre-season, though they came up just short against St Helens recently, and the club is now actively seeking sponsorship opportunities to support the new era. With three brand new kits and a refreshed squad in place, there's plenty of optimism as the team aims for promotion this season.
